scorecard.venue: Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Uppal, Hyderabad

batting.name: Priyansh Arya
batting.dismissal: c Nithish Kumar Reddy b HV Patel

batting.name: P Simran Singh
batting.dismissal: c PJ Cummins b E Malinga

batting.name: SS Iyer
batting.dismissal: c TM Head b HV Patel

batting.name: TM Head
batting.dismissal: c GJ Maxwell b YS Chahal

batting.name: Abhishek Sharma
batting.dismissal: c P Dubey b Arshdeep Singh

balls.text: Stoinis goes into the stands again. Shami has finished on 4-0-75-0. WOWZA! The second-most expensive spell in the history of IPL. Low full toss down leg. Stoinis thumps him over deep square leg and that is a grandstand finish for Punjab Kings, who have stormed to 245 for 6
Stoinis in the house, ladies and gentlemen! Back of a length ball that just sits up for Stoinis, who tonks this for a 96m over deep midwicket.
Two in two and Shami's figures have taken a beating! This was a low full toss on leg stump. Stoinis brings out the big levers and gets enough power to clear deep midwicket
Going, going, gone! Length ball on leg stump, Stoinis gets under it and pummels this for a 93m six over wide long-on
Goes high.... very high and lands in no man's land. Fuller in length on the stumps, Stoinis skews this straight up but the ball falls inside the 30-yard circle around the midwicket region
Starts well. Fuller in length on the stumps. Jansen backs away looking to go over covers, but can only skew it off the inside half of the bat to deep midwicket
No, he can't. Right in Stoinis' arc on off stump and this time he does not miss out. Muscles this over mid-off for a four
Only a single again. Low full toss just outside leg stump. Jansen stays legside of the ball but can only push this to extra cover
That was in the slot outside off, but Stoinis can't get under it. Muscles this to mid-off, where Reddy intercepts
Another excellent yorker right on off stump and all Stoinis can do is toe-end it back to the bowler
Knee high full toss down leg. Jansen gives himself room and looks for a clip, but he misses and wears this on the pad
Yorker on off stump, he digs this to extra cover for a run
Low full toss on middle stump, Jansen clips this to the left of deep midwicket for a couple of runs
Slower back of a length ball outside off, he mistimes his cut towards deep point
Fuller on pace on off stump, he pushes to long-on for a run

A fourth wicket for Harshal and this is the big wicket of Iyer. Slower short of a length ball outside off. He looks to cut this up and over point, but there is no pace to work with. All he can do it pat this straight to the point fielder where Head makes no mistake.
On a length outside off, he pushes towards extra cover and sets off

3 off 7, and that's another failure for Maxwell in IPL 2025. Slower dipping full toss just outside off stump. Maxwell goes reverse, is totally done in by the slower ball and the ball ricochets off his pad and thuds into off stump. Third wicket for Harshal this evening

Three in three! Just the kind of start to the death overs that Iyer would have liked. Fuller in length outside off. Iyer mistimes this right off the bottom of the bat over extra cover. But, he gets enough power to get the ball to the boundary
Fine again, four again! Another knee-high full toss down leg as Iyer gets across and works this to the right of short fine leg
Wayward delivery and Iyer isn't missing out on these. Low full toss on leg stump, he toe-ends this fine and with short fine leg inside the circle, there was no stopping this
Good length ball at pace outside off stump that is scythed to deep cover by Maxwell
Fuller in length tailing back into Iyer, he loses his shape and slogs this to deep midwicket
Right in the arc and Iyer cashes in. In the slot outside off and Iyer pumps this over extra cover for a four

Does he end his spell with a wicket? Nope. But that is an excellent spell from Ansari. Gets the legbreak to fizz through outside off. Maxwell eyes a big hit by giving himself room, is nowhere near it. Klaasen whips off the bails in a flash, but Maxwell was back
Flatter and on a length on middle, Iyer thumps this to long-on
Beaten! Lands the legbrak on middle and gets it turn away from Iyer. He looks to go up and over again, but can't lay a bat on it
Big turn but that was well outside off. Called a wide

Up, up and out of the park. Floated outside off stump, he gives himself room and stays leg side of the ball. Was looking to go inside-out over cover, and while he did not get it off the middle, had enough power to clear the ropes, around the wide long-off region
Gets some extra bounce on the tossed up leggie just on off. Maxwell pushes towards cover for a run
Flatter legbreak on leg stump, worked to deep midwicket
A hint of reverse swing into the right-hander on the fuller side on middle. Iyer digs this to long-on
Another low full toss that tails back into Iyer on middle and leg. He flicks this to Abhishek at deep backward square leg, who misfields and concedes an extra run
Length ball tailing back into Maxwell who works this to deep square leg
Oh, the slower ball has gone horribly wrong for Harshal. The ball slips out of his hand, waaaay down leg. Nothing the keeper could do there
On a length just outside off stump, Maxwell mistimes back towards the bowler
Fuller outside off, he pushes to mid-off

Big shout for lbw... not given. SRH, though have reviewed. Impact will be the question here? Did Shashank get outside the line? On a length homing in on off stump. Shashank shimmies down the track and looks to work this to the on-side. He misses and is rapped on the pad. No bat, but where's the impact? Oh, it's in line. Surely, that's going crashing the stumps? Oh, yes. Thudding into leg stump, and Shashank is out of here. Excellent review from Harshal and Cummins
gets the ball to tail back into Shashank around off stump. Reverse swing? Shashank skews it off the inside half of the bat down to deep backward square leg
Fuller length ball outside off, he pushes towards point for a run
Low full toss outside off, he gets this to long-off to get off the mark
Eyes the yorker again but that was down leg. Called a wide

Oh, surely that's plumb. Yep, the umpire's finger is up in a jiffy. Wadhera doesn't even bother to review. Nails the yorker on off stump. Wadhera was eyeing the cheeky scoop/ramp. Is nowhere near it and once the ball thudded into his pad, it was curtains for him. Oh, hang on... hang on. Were we too quick to judge? The replays confirm the impact here was umpire's call and the ball would have missed off stump. As it turns out, Wadhera should have reviewed

Oh, that was pre-meditated and it's a good thing he got some bat on it. Length ball homing in on middle stump. Wadhera jumps right across too early. Eyes a scoop and gets it very fine just past the keeper.
Slower offcutter well outside off. Wadhera is completely foxed by it as the ball goes to the keeper on the bounce
Slower back of a length ball to finish the over on leg stump. Wadhera pulls to deep backward square leg
Steps right across to the length ball on leg stump and helps this neatly very fine. The fielder is fairly square and Wadhera gets an important four
Hard lengths just outside off, he bunts this to long-off

Opens the face of the blade and captain Iyer reaches a 22-ball fifty. Full and well outside off, he throws his bat at it, and squirts it of the outside half of the blade past the keeper. That's Iyer's fastest fifty in the IPL.
Back of a length ball on Wadhera's hips, he helps this to deep backward square leg
Good length ball on off, he pushes towards extra cover

Miscued... miscued but Abhishek has made a mess of it at long-off. Floated outside off gently. Iyer tries to get under it, isn't able to and balloons it straight up. Abhishek settles under, but does not realise where the rope is behind him. Ends up treading on it, and spills the catch, eventually
Flatter legbreak on off as Wadhera shimmies down and eases to deep midwicket
Short of a length delivery darted in on middle. Think it was the topspinner as Ansari got some extra bounce. Iyer pulls to deep square leg
Flatter and down leg, called a wide
Knee-high full toss on off stump, Iyer goes reverse now and thumps this over point for four.
Goes through with the shot and clears long-off. Not of the middle of the blade, but just enough power. Was gently looped up outside off. Iyer stays still and pummels it.
Gently tossed up well outside off and away from Wadhera's hitting arc. He mistimes to long-on
An appeal for lbw, but that was sliding down leg stump. Gets the ball to curve back full into Iyer. He misses the flick and is rapped on the pad, but the angle was always taking the ball down leg.
Nails the yorker outside off stump, Iyer brings down his just in time to jam this back to the bowler
Slower offcutter dug into the surface outside off. Wadhera waits for it and turns this behind square for a run
Goes full now on middle and leg stump, Iyer digs this down to wide long-on for a run
TONKED... into second tier. Slower back of a length ofccuter outside off. The ball sits up nicely for Iyer to extend his arms and muscle this miles over long-on
Fuller on leg stump, he works this to deep backward square leg for a run
Pre-meditated reverse sweep, looked like Wadhera wanted to go aerial. Gloves it in the end, finds short third. Pace just 81ks
Goes back in the crease, clears the front leg and chips a pull to long-on. Shortish ball was at the body
Quicker ball, touch fuller and wider. Wadhera went back in the crease for a cut but checked his shot as the ball hurried on, ended up bunting it through cover
Googly on a length lands wide and turns further away. It's cut to cover
Sweeps the loopy wide full ball to short fine leg
Not yet. Punched to long-on
Picked up and deep fine leg was too square. Was a back-of-length ball just over top of front pad, this was over leg stump, so Wadhera didn't have to move about. Just waited and flicked it flat
Yorker on fourth, jammed with an open face towards cover

Slot ball's clobbered, deep midwicket's in play... but it clears him! Kishan ran to the left, reached out and jumped but the ball kept angling away. Was a slower ball outside off, was essentially a slog. Went very flat
Halfway ball at the hips, Wadhera was caught between shots -  flick and a pull. He got beaten and the ball deflected off his body to the leg side
Tucks the length ball off the hips through midwicket
Bumper just outside off, too high. Let go
Slow yorker turned into a high-ish full toss, the batter was taken aback; manages to bunt it towards midwicket
Another economical over. No turn for Zeeshan but he was happy to toss it up and change his lines. This was a length ball outside off, cut to deep point
Iyer makes room and drives the floaty full ball to long-off.
Overthrows, throw from point was between bowler and Iyer, who was running towards the crease, and there was no one behind. Was a length ball outside off that was cut
Brave. Floaty length ball just outside off, square driven through cover point
Length at the stumps, tries to turn it to square leg. Gets a leading edge, ball pops to the off side
Slow yorker turned into a high-ish full toss
Yorker around fifth, steered to deep point with a drive

Into the pitch brings Malinga's maiden IPL wicket. Slower one around fifth stump, sat up proper but rose to around shoulder height. Prabhsimran stood leg side of the ball, waited a second and flat-batted it with all his might. Might still have been early on it, looked to have hit a touch low too. Mid-off took a comfortable low catch
Off-stump yorker at 142ks. Slingly from Malinga, so yeah, we have another side-armer. Jammed to deep point
Wide yorker. 111ks. Around sixth-stump, Iyer tried to slice it through third, plonked the toe of the open-faced bat into the ground but doesn't connect with ball
Full on the pads, whipped to midwicket
Slower full toss dips a bit but is around knee-roll height, slapped to cover
Slower one into the pitch is launched. In the air for a while but the pull shot clears the midwicket boundary. Didn't bounce much, gave ample time for Iyer to load up
Shot a ball from Prabhsimran, tries to wallop it across the line with a swing across the hip. Underedges the length ball from outside off to deep square leg

Almost a spekkie at cover, that ball was hovering at pace and Abhishek dove to the right. Tried to take it with both hands, got hands on it but it sped away. Was a wide fullish ball that was slapped hard
Chips a length ball on middle over the bowler, stopped at the edge of the circle
Quick single to backward point despite Iyer being a touch late. Was a length ball outside off to which the batter danced down. He then bunted it with an open bat face
Slower short ball lands very wide, sits up around top-of-shoulder height. It angled in towards sixth stump and Prabhsimran forehanded it straight of mid-on
Ishan misfields this time. He rushed left to try and deny the single at mid-on but couldn't pick up the ball and had to run back. Was a low full toss at the stumps that was punched with a check
Batter makes room and gets followed with a full ball, flicked nicely. Ishan chases to the right from mid-on, dives full length and reaches out to stop it
SRH have realised they have no margins of error. Cummins is bowling like it's the death. Yorks the batter this time, on leg stump, jammed in front
Prabhsimran goes back in the crease and gets under the full, wide ball. He frees his arms and clatters is straight of mid-off
Wide yorker is past the tramline, Prabhsimran reaches out and tries to jam it behind point. Misses
Cummins misses the on-pace yorker, but he followed the batter who was making room. The 142ks highish full toss was whipped to mid-on
More slow stuff. Wide on a length, cut to cover

Priyansh's fun innings ends but Punjab will take a 13-ball 36. Another slower ball, but this is from over the wicket and on a length. The batter moved outside off early and swiped across with a mostly horizontal bat. Got a top edge that skied, midwicket ran back and took it with a tumble on the back.
Harshal goes wide again, the full ball is outside the tramline. Let go
Slower slot ball is mullered over the bowler. Four or six? It's smashed the cushion. Was an offcutter on fifth stump. The batter stood leg side of the ball and slugged across
Forceful pull isn't middled, goes to deep square leg - running to his right - on the bounce. Was a shortish ball just outside off

Prabhsimran danced down too early, Harshal went super-short and got tennis-ball bounce; the batter stopped in his tracks, waited for the ball to pass around head-height and cut it over short third. Brilliant adjustment
Shortish skiddy ball cants in to the front thigh pad. Looked to have gone slow off the pitch, beat the flick and deflected back in front
SRH going into death-bowling mode. Harshal aimed for the wide yorker, bowled a high-ish full toss. Arya carves it aerially, finds deep point

Full toss is whacked, deep square leg is in play... but it clears him. Was a high-ish full toss, around thigh-high at the stumps, Prabhsimran swung through the line. Think he wanted to go over mid-on, got it off the inside-half of the bat. Got it 81 metres far. Fifty up in three overs for Punjab
Short ball rises around rib-height, it's pulled to deep midwicket
Hard length at the hips, flicked to short fine leg
Shami goes for the yorker, bowls a 140ks low fully on the pads, flicked nicely through midwicket. Aniket runs to the right, looked like he might reach it but doesn't in the end.
Carved over cover, it's raining sixes. Again, not a bad ball but the pace and bounce is perfect for batters on this pitch. Arya had to make no adjustment, just whacked it off the top of the bounce
Bashes a hard-length ball over the bowler. It's a flat-bat pull, the stillness is a feature from Arya yet again.

Slower one is cut very late, not sure Prabhsimran wanted to go aerial but found the gap between short third and backward point. Was a three-quarter length ball that was very wide and the batter had to reach out to get the edge
Fullish on middle and leg, flicked to midwicket
Nails the yorker. Right on middle stump, landed around the crease. Priyansh jams it towards midwicket and the bowler chased it
Yorker a stump's width down leg goes past the attempted flick
Glanced through fine leg. The fullish ball was on middle and leg, Arya waited again and helped it along the way
Picked up into the second stand over square leg. 137ks length ball, slight wobble on it, rose towards top of middle. Priyansh stood still and shovelled it with a short back-lift and follow-through
Fullish on middle, defended to cover

Dances down again, opens up sweeper cover this time. It's another flat-bat slap, this ball is slightly fuller but still a three-quarter length. The shot was mostly bottom-handed and the bat-face turned upon impact but it didn't matter, the ball cannoned flat in the gap
Flayed again, wide of mid-off this time. This was an outswinger on a length, fifth-stump line.
Out? No, clears mid-off easily despite not middling the flat-bat hit. Prabhsimran danced down the ground and picked it off a length, he made room too and went through with the shot.
Length outside off, bunted to cover point

Pitched up and that's driven past the bowler. Kishan loses the ball along the sponsor mat, which had white text on a black background. Camouflage in play. The batters run two in the meantime... but it'll be only one as the batters ran one short. Replay shows Priyansh just wasn't looking while grounding the bat, was a few inches behind
No swing, the length ball is a touch too straight. Flicked uppishly off the hip, through square leg

That's that! Klaasen gets it done in style and SRH have notched up the second-highest chase in the IPL history.  And they get it done in a mere 18.3 overs. My word! What an incredible chase we have witnessed today. Klaasen provides the finishing touches as he slices this full toss over point to invoke joyous  scenes in the SRH changeroom. SRH have chased down 245 with nine balls to spare. Let that sink in.
On a length outside off, he chips this to long-off
Fuller length ball on off stump, he works this to deep midwicket with soft hands
Klaasen won't miss out two in a row. Slower back of a length ball that just sits up on the surface for Klaasen to pump it waaaaay over deep midwicket
Beaten all ends up! Slower length ball well outside off, he eyes a powerful slog. Gets beaten
Fuller outside off angling away from Kishan who drives on the up to deep cover
Kishan is away. Was a length ball outside off. Kishan throws his bat at it and flays this to the left of deep cover
Gets the low full toss to tail back in on middle, Klaasen gets his bat down in time to work this to deep backward square leg
CLUBBED! Banged in short just outside off. Klaasen gets into position early and gets on top of the bounce to slam the pull in the gap between long-on and deep midwicket
On a length angling away from Klaasen who throws his bat at it and can only drag this behind square for a run
Good bouncer! He gets that on line just outside off, Klaasen was eyeing a pull but misses
Sharp back of a length ball onto his body. Kishan is cramped for room and mistimes his attempted pull/hook to deep square leg
Starts off with a bouncer on off, Kishan sways out of the way

Finally, finally Abhishek departs. But, oh my word, what an unbelievable knock this has been. The entire stadium rises up as he walks back finishing on 141 off 55 balls. Gets a hug from Arshdeep, and a pat on the back from Wadhera. Was a length ball on his pads, he whisks it but for once can't get enough power behind it. Deep midwicket runs in and takes a catch. He removes his helmet and raises his bat to everyone all around the stadium. Phew!
Inside-edge for four. Abhishek gets lucky once more. Full and outside off, he throws his bat at it, and gets a thick inside-edge past the keeper
Very full and outside off, he jams this to extra cover.
Back of a length ball down leg, he helps this to deep backward square leg.
Banged in short on middle, he pulls to deep square leg for a run

How's he doing this? This is EA cricket on cheat code, this is unreal striking. He shows Thakur all of his stumps and is right across. Thakur bowls this on leg stump and Abhishek clips this fine for four. WOW. Abhishek now has the highest score by any Indian in the IPL as he moves to 135 off 49.
I am running out of superlatives, so I'll just describe the ball. On a length well outside off, he gets right across and dumps Thakur over long-on.
Length on off, he tonks this back to the bowler

Catishek's luck continues. He's shanked that completely, but the ball once more falls in no-man's land. Tossed up well outside off, he looks to go up and over, but skews it straight up but the ball falls in the vacant extra cover region
Going, going and out of here. He's mistimed this big time, but it doesn't mater does it. They are all travelling. Floated on off, he slogs this over deep midwicket for six
Floats this very slowly on middle stump, but Abhishek is unstoppable tonight. Gets right inside the line and sweeps this over short fine leg.
Floated well outside off stump, but this is outside the tramline. Called a wide
SIX MORE! Fired in at 90.7kph on leg stump. Abhishek shuffles just a touch across and hacks this over deep backward square leg for another half a dozen
Just a touch slow outside off stump, he shuffles across and mistimes to long-off

Nicely done. Klaasen gives himself a lot of room by backing away. Chahal pushes this well outside off and out of Klaasen's reach. Hang on, Klaasen has reviewed for a wide.  Didn't seem that way on first glance. That's well inside the tramline, and SRH lose a review
Banged in short on leg stump, he pulls to deep square leg to retain strike
Misses out. In his hitting arc outside off stump, Abhishek drags this to the right deep backward square leg for a run
Another fuller length ball quite a way outside off. This time it is called a wide
Fuller and well outside off stump, Abhishek lets that go. Not called a wide. Oh, wasn't that outside the tramline?
BANG! Right in the slot outside off and Abhishek hacks this over long-on for a huge six. What a shot that!
Hard length on his pad, he fails to work this away and he wears this on the pad. Abhishek scrambles through for a run
Fuller well outside off, he gets a thick inside-edge past off stump for a run

A 100 of the highest order, a 100 that's turned around the season around for Abhishek, a 100 to prove a point! Tossed up on off, he clips to wide long-on. Pumps his fist in delight, raises his bat to the crowd around, removes his helmet and then takes a piece of paper from his pocket to raise to the crowd. Wonder what's this about? He gets there off just 40 balls. What a knock! This one's for the Orange Army is what was scribbled on that piece of paper. WOW!
Tossed up down leg, Klaasen clips this to deep midwicket
Quicker length ball on off stump, Abhishek eases to long-on to move to 99
Flatter on leg stump, he works this to deep backward square leg

Is that the first one? Yes, it is. Chahal gets Head and the partnership ends on 171 in 12.2 overs. Tossed up outside off. Head looks to thump this across the line, gets a top edge that balloons straight up with Maxwell doing the rest at long-on. The Uppal crowd rise up in unison
HUMONGOUS!   Just a stifle short on off stump, Head rocks back and tonks him over deep midwicket.
Not yet. Back of a length ball angling across Abhishek who gets an under-edge to short third
Moves to 98! Back of a length ball on well outside off stump, but Abhishek is up the task. Gets riiiight across and helps this over short fine leg. The ball flies away on this outfield
Shuffles right across again and slices this over short third. Back of a length ball outside off, he gets it for four more
Shuffles right across the off stump, but Shashank cleverly follows him and cramps him for room. The ball thuds into his thigh pad as he misses the scoop
Back of a length ball outside off, he flat-bats this back past the bowler. Maxwell hares across from long-on and parries the ball to long-off.
Fuller in length outside off, Head hacks this back at Shashank who does not collect cleanly and concedes a run
Very full, almost yorker length on middle, Head squeezes this towards extra cover
SPANKED! Flatter outside off stump, he stays still and absolutely pummels this to the right of long-off
Shimmies down the track and clips the full ball on middle and leg to deep midwicket
Flatter on off, he gets it down to long-off

The errors are compounding.  Slogs the length ball in the gap between deep midwicket and long-on. The fielder at deep midwicket dives and parries the ball to Maxwell, who makes a meal of it. Head notches up a 31-ball fifty, which I must add has looked slow. Says something about the knock Abhishek is playing
Flatter length ball on middle, he gets a thick inside-edge onto pad
How can anyone do that? Ridiculous shot. Abhishek went too far across to an off-stump yorker, it was like he'd be bowled, but he went through with the scoop and got it through fine leg
Abhishek's able to play the field this time. Has a lateral shuffle to get inside the line of the back-of-length ball and paddles it on the move. Somehow gets it through short fine leg
And Jansen bowls a slower wide bouncer. Abhishek tried following it, shaped for the late cut before letting it go He thought it was above head, ump doesn't agree

Left-handed helicopter shot, high and far. The crowd is ballistic but that sound isn't as pure as the one off the bat. Was a fullish ball outside off, Abhishek walked across and whipped it. Got whiplash almost
Pulled flat over square leg. Short ball around head-height, that's a good ball under normal circumstances but it's pulled with no fuss
Wide not given, Abhishek went across the line and went for the slog sweep, the full slower ball down leg went past bat
Length at the pads, tries to whip it square. Ball hits pad
Head makes room and is followed by a quick length ball, worked back to the bowler. Maxwell takes a shy at the stumps. Head's bemused, has a fiery word with Maxwell, who's not as into it

Head stays in the crease this time and pummels one again. The pull is close to the car over midwicket, 84-metre six. Absolutely no assistance for the bowler. SRH are halfway to the target just 52 balls into their innings
Head keeps making room, manages to free his arms and pulls over wide long-on. That was shortish and slow, easy pickings
Stumping missed? No, that nutmegged off the bat. Abhishek charged down and tried to drive through the line, got to the pitch but inside edged it between his feet. Keeper ran left to stop it
Dances down and tucks the length ball on the pads to deep square leg
Shortish and wide again, slapped to long-off
Shortish, wide-ish and it's cut hard. Head went deep in the crease, got the front leg out the way while smacking it between point and backward point.
Cut hard, deep cover runs to the right. Shashank there, pushes it in, but it travels a few metres, which requires him to run and the batters to take three
Googly is short, sits up and is pulled over midwicket. 75 metres far. Risk free almost
Cuts the shortish ball to long-off

Creates a chance first ball, but can't take it. There was no mid-on, so Chahal ran back, the high ball swirled away and he dove late and tried to take it with both hands. He almost settled underneath, but when he paused he realised that he needs to take an extra jump. He couldn't judge how far away it was from him. The ball popped off the palms, into the grass. Was a shortish ball outside off that Abhishek pulled
Pulls the shortish ball to deep midwicket. Good overs for Kings
Quiet over so far and Head thumps one through the line, but Arshdeep saves a couple running to the right from long-on.
Dances down, think Maxwell saw him, and shortened his length. Just 83ks though, following the batter too. Bunted to long-off
Length on the pads, whipped off the back foot to deep midwicket
Length down leg, goes past the slog sweep
Full on leg, clipped through backward square leg
Fifty up for Abhishek, in just 19 balls. Gets there with a thinly edged straight drive that goes past leg stump and straight of short fine leg.
Slower bouncer sits up outside off, Head leans across and pulls it over midwicket. Without sideways movement, there is no stopping elite batters, is there?

Slower wide yorker lands just in front of the crease and is clearly past the tramline. Let go. Stoinis gave a thumbs up while turning back but is surprised while looking at the ump. He accepts the call with a smile though
Looked like that swung in late. Okay, maybe not, full ball on fifth, Head drives hard off the inside-half of the bat. Gets it to mid-on
Slow and wide on a length, cut to deep point. 112ks
More silence but that won't stay for long. Short ball is pulled to midwicket
On-pace bouncer just under chest-height. Pulled off the bottom of the bat, to midwicket on the bounce it goes.
And so, Head tries to drag it through the leg side, finds mid-on with the pull. Looked like the slower one. Into the pitch, the angle was sharp, finished well outside off
Swipes across the line, not middled, gets a couple to cow corner
Down leg, beaten on the pull. The keeper's hit on the glove and the ball falls in front
Makes room again and whacks it again. The back-lift is sky high and he powers another drive through cover. He was right to the pitch too
Dances down and goes inside out over sweeper cover. Great skill to open the face of the bat while connecting with a length ball that he turned into a full one
Full ball is worked to long-on

Another wide down leg, but Maxwell is sure that's out caught behind. Shreyas asks the keeper, don't think he's fully sure but will take the review.. 93ks length ball kept angling down and passed the bat as Head's upper-body slanted to the right with him trying to flick the ball. The noise came from ball brushing the trouser
Gets away with a wide down leg. That length ball was a touch loopier and Head tried to glance it
Full and flat on off, 92ks, driven to long-off
Shortish outside off, pulled off the bottom-half of the bat to mid-on. 138ks
Wide yorker. The angle's sharp on it and it lands well outside the tramline. Easy leave

Abhishek's luck index will be through the roof tonight, he's skied a cut but it falls in the middle of the outfield despite three fielders - backward point, cover, deep point - running towards the ball.

Wide not given and Abhishek reviews straightaway. Looked risky as he went back and a touch across. The slower one is fullish and went past the regular tramline. But the imaginary line moved a touch as Abhishek had moved to fourth. But no part of the ball is inside the line, so it's given wide
Free hit's monstered! Gayle-esque flick over square leg from Abhishek. Cleared the front foot, whacked it across the line

Fun's over for Abhishek as it's taken at deep-backward point. Oh no, it continues actually as the klaxon goes off. Crowd's alive again after going quiet. A scamble-seam length ball on off was cut straight to Shashank, who took the catch. Thakur was delighted initially but had to hide his face and walk back in disappointment
Slugged high, sails over midwicket and SRH's fifty is up in 21 balls. Volume's at its highest from the crowd too. Looked like a wobble ball, on a length around top of off
Abhishek gets away with a top-edged pull by clearing short fine leg. The ball races along the turf for four more. Was a good bouncer, around head height
Swing and a miss. Pre-meditated shot. Abhishek danced down and tried to carve it over cover, the length ball rose above his bat
Good lord it's loud as the boundaries continue to pour. Head makes room and gets followed by a full ball, he's beside it and is able to drive through the line. Over the bowler
One-legged flick through long leg. Helped along with the angle. Was a length ball on top of front pad
Off side's stacked behind square but Head cuts it in the gap. Didn't middle it, hit around the bottom of the sticker, ball flew at a catching height to point's right
Bumper around the shoulder. Wide not given. 135ks, let go. One for the over called, crowd doesn't like it
Beaten on the upper cut. Shortish ball just outside off, Head tried to go over the keeper

Toes a drive, ball doesn't carry to mid-on. Run-out chance... but there's no direct hit. All happening. Was a full ball on fourth that Head tried to drive over the infield, Maxwell tried to get it on the half-volley, got hit on the thigh and he turned around as the ball ricocheted in front. He then took a shy at the non-striker's, where Abhishek had given up, and missed
Backward point was the only fielder out on the off side and Abhishek flays it over cover. Was a fullish ball on leg stump, the batter made a lot of room while dancing down to gain access

Deep-backward square leg in place, he races to the right but can't stop it. The crowd is ecstatic! Short ball was at the body, around chest-height, Abhishek was cramped a bit but went through with the shot
Clear the front leg and blap it across the line, shows how much trust the batters have in the pitch. Three-quarter-length ball at the stumps and Abhishek showed it no mercy
Stoinis at catching cover leaps up but can't grab it, tried to take a right-hander while mid-air, just got fingertips on it. Was a length ball that Abhishek had slapped
Flayed and the edge goes over short third. Abhishek looked to be going over point. Was a 138ks length ball on fifth
Cut late, finds deep-backward point. Length ball around sixth, it looked to have moved away
More outswing. Fullish length ball on off, defended nicely towards mid-on for a quick single
Guides the wide-ish length ball to short third
Slapped on one foot over cover. Length ball rose around waist-height, Head leapt and cut it
Length around fifth, Head leaves it and practises a gentle cut right after

Inswing this time, Head's got nothing on it yet almost gets six over cover. Three-quarter length, curving in towards top of off, Head tried to pick it up on the rise, over midwicket, got a leading edge that went real high, but it just kept travelling
Outswing found and it's left alone. Might be the first of the day. Good ball though, three-quarter length just outside off
